name: What is the typical lifespan of a custom-built tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of a custom-built tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-constructed custom tiny home, especially one built to traditional residential standards, can have a lifespan comparable to a conventional home, often exceeding 50 years. For tiny homes on wheels, the lifespan can be similar if properly maintained and regularly inspected, though the trailer chassis itself may have a different longevity. Key factors influencing lifespan include the quality of materials used, the construction methods, and ongoing maintenance. We use durable materials and proven building practices to ensure longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: The lifespan of a custom-built tiny home can exceed 50 years, similar to traditional homes, especially with quality materials and regular maintenance.
